releaseNotes:
﻿## Guest Inbox
- Sent folder loads about 50 messages at a time with Load more (newest first)
- Sent rows show recipients (To:) instead of Unknown sender
- Reply attachments show per-file and combined size, with a clear warning before send
- Combined attachment limit includes standard files; oversized sets are blocked before SMTP
- Failed attachment sends keep the reply draft open

## Conferences
- Link multiple Guest Inbox email conversations to one conference (organizer, catering, finance, etc.)
- Create Conference or Conference inquiry from Guest Inbox, with optional role and Primary thread
- Conference edit page shows compact Email conversations (open, role, primary, unlink)
- Link an existing conversation from the conference page
- Email links survive inquiry to confirmed

## Contacts / households
- Household directory and household member management improvements
- Safer contact autofill / channel handling

## Settings
- App-wide time format preference (12h / 24h) on key schedule and inbox surfaces

## Fixes
- Client/server import boundaries so production build stays clean
